title: Vietnamese-Style Garlic Lime Beef Rice Noodles
summary: A bright, savoury dinner of seared garlic beef tossed with rice noodles, crunchy vegetables, lime and herbs. It is fresh and punchy with a high-protein portion of beef in each serving.
steps: Cook the rice noodles according to the packet instructions until just tender, then drain and rinse under cold water. Drain well and set aside.

In a bowl, mix the garlic, lime juice, soy sauce, fish sauce, brown sugar, sesame oil, black pepper and half the vegetable oil. Add the sliced beef and toss to coat. Leave to marinate for 10 minutes while you prepare the vegetables.
Put the carrot, cucumber, red pepper, bean sprouts, spring onions, mint, coriander and chilli in a large serving bowl. Add the drained noodles and toss lightly.

Heat a large frying pan or wok over high heat until very hot. Add the remaining vegetable oil, then lift the beef from the marinade and sear in a single layer for 2–3 minutes, turning once, until browned at the edges and just cooked through. Cook in batches if needed so the beef sears rather than steams.
Pour the remaining marinade into the hot pan and bubble for 30–60 seconds until glossy and fragrant, then return all the beef to the pan and toss to coat. Taste and add the salt only if needed.
Tip the hot garlic lime beef and pan juices over the noodles and vegetables. Toss well, scatter with chopped peanuts, and serve immediately with extra lime if liked.
